=== authenticated /en/admin/users ===
HTTP 200 url=http://localhost:3000/en/admin/users
<title>vereinfacht – digitale Vereinsverwaltung</title>
      4 Jane Doe
      8 Users
     27 users
=== unauthenticated /en/admin/users (expect redirect) ===
HTTP 307 redirect=http://localhost:3000/admin/auth/login

observation.command: cd /tmp; echo "=== authenticated /en/admin/users ==="; curl -s -b naj.txt -m 40 -o /tmp/users.html -w "HTTP %{http_code} url=%{url_effective}\n" -L http://localhost:3000/en/admin/users; grep -oiE '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/users.html | head; grep -oiE 'Jane Doe|users|list' /tmp/users.html | sort | uniq -c | head; echo "=== unauthenticated /en/admin/users (expect redirect) ==="; curl -s -m 30 -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" http://localhost:3000/en/admin/users
